blurb: `expect Cap.op called` checks the calls recorded for one operation of a capability, so `op` must be declared by that capability. A misspelt or renamed operation would match no call, so it is refused instead of leaving the check vacuous. Use the name the capability declares. A capability the unit does not consume is `bynk.observe.not_a_seam`.
summary: An observation names an operation the capability does not declare.
